Title: Employee Damage Recovery & Payroll Deductions
Specific Source Locations: New ID assigned in this export; see source references below.
Full Change Note: New SOP ID assigned; no existing reference renumbered.
Guidance Question: Approve a separate, legally reviewed recovery agreement and decision process before deductions or offsets are used.
Guidance Needed:
Legacy sources impose automatic pay-cycle deductions, escrow recovery, fines or legal costs. Current ALL-021 and MGT-016 prohibit automatic or unauthorized wage recovery. Confirm which provisions are withdrawn or replaced.
Distinguish employees from genuine independent contractors and determine applicable authorization, wage/overtime/salary protections and final-pay requirements. A policy acknowledgment alone must not be assumed sufficient for every deduction.
Define investigation of responsibility, evidence, written notice, employee response, actual supported loss, approval, any separate agreement, ledger and dispute process. Do not withhold earned final pay until property is returned.
Reconcile the technology policy’s 10-day replacement option with the equipment policy’s same-pay-period language; identify any existing valid escrow agreements rather than assuming an escrow exists.

Title: Insurance Disclosure & Claim Settlement Authority
Specific Source Locations: New ID assigned in this export; see source references below.

Guidance Question: Confirm actual policy obligations, insurer notice, disclosure requirements and settlement approval limits.
Guidance Needed:

Identify the actual insurer/agent notification route, relevant coverage, permitted admissions, counsel handoff, settlement approver and written limits. Do not invent coverage or guarantee insurer acceptance.
Confirm repair-shop choice, reasonable mitigation/rental expenses, settlement documentation and exceptions. The $50 gift-card permission in the 4Runner email was case-specific, not a standing settlement limit.

Title: Pre-Release Repairs & Customer Transportation
Specific Source Locations: New ID assigned in this export; see source references below.
Full Change Note: New SOP ID assigned; no existing reference renumbered.
Guidance Question: Approve repair consent, lawful release timing and transportation authorization without using a claim to delay access or release.
Guidance Needed:
S03 suggests later pickup appointments or a one-hour wait to correct damage. Confirm that staff may not use repair planning to impose an unauthorized delay on a person entitled to access or release.
Define customer consent, qualified repair personnel, scope, safety assessment and documentation before touching the vehicle. Do not conceal damage through an undocumented repair.
Clarify when transportation or rental expenses are approved, who approves them, any limits and who communicates the arrangement. Reconcile the “owner insists” language with reasonable mitigation and settlement authority.
Keep courtesy return transportation for a company-caused tow distinct from damage repair transportation and from normal roadside rideshare sales.
